$comment: Cross-language SSoT for the FaaS order status machine. Every SDK loads this in its tests so the terminal-status set is identical across languages.

failure_reasons.$comment: Every `failure_reason` a tenant can receive on GET /v1/orders/:id or a webhook, and what it says about their money. The `held` values mean the order has not finished; only `reversal_unsettled` means the tenant does NOT have their money back. Internal reasons are mapped to these at the API edge, so this list is exhaustive for the wire.
